scope: Development failure modes, not factual labels or measured report scores

cases.expectation: Amount scale and share scale must remain distinct; preserve existing billion/yi compatibility checks without adding a Chinese campaign.
A quarterly terminal cash flow cannot be capitalized as an annual perpetuity.
Do not divide present total equity value by a future buyback-reduced share count.
Consolidated income including noncontrolling interests cannot substitute for common-shareholder income.
A blanket reviewed boolean cannot authorize omission of a material caveat.
A targeted question must be able to retrieve relevant text beyond the introductory source excerpt.
Changing base assumptions must invalidate and recompute dependent sensitivity/scenario outputs.
Issuer guidance and analyst estimates are distinct; missing consensus remains unknown.
A valid citation ID or lexical match does not establish entailment or resolve a question.
